title: 8 Port FTTH Fiber Joint & Distribution Box – Code 105

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The 8 Port FTTH Fiber Joint & Distribution Box – Code 105 is a high-performance fiber enclosure designed for stable and professional FTTH & FTTX network installations. Built with durable ABS material, this fiber distribution box protects splicing points and ensures clean, organized cable management for home, office, and ISP fiber networks in Bangladesh.


Its 8-port layout makes it ideal for multi-line fiber distribution, ONU/ONT connections, and small-to-medium FTTH projects. OTECH BD offers this model for installers who need reliable, long-lasting fiber infrastructure equipment.

Key Features


  • 8 Dedicated Fiber Ports – Ideal for FTTH, FTTX, and ISP network distribution.
  • Durable ABS Construction – Heat-resistant and built for long-term performance.
  • Secure Fiber Splicing Protection – Keeps joints, pigtails, and connectors safe.
  • Moisture & Dust Resistant – Ensures stable fiber performance in any indoor setup.
  • Easy Wall-Mount Design – Supports clean, professional installation.
  • Perfect for FTTH Installers in Bangladesh – Reliable choice for ISPs and network technicians.
